rule: An enum constant `E.C` has type `E`. | **PHP**: namespace-qualified with dots: `App.Svc#run`; `$this->m()` → `App.Svc#m`; `Cls::m()` → resolved class `#m`.
notes: Suit::Hearts is an enum constant of type App.Suit (decision A) → ->color() is App.Suit#color, high. Case declarations and the constant reads (Suit::Hearts, self::Hearts) are not calls. call_type: SPEC lists direct|method without defining them; this corpus uses method for every callee of the form Type#m / recv.m / .m (instance and static member calls) and direct for free functions, bare names and named nested functions.
